meta.title: COH3 Maps - All Multiplayer Maps
meta.description: Browse all Company of Heroes 3 multiplayer maps. Filter by game mode, see resource point layouts, map sizes and community maps.

page.title: Company of Heroes 3 Maps
page.subtitle: Browse all the multiplayer maps in the game with their resource layouts.
page.noMaps: No maps match the selected filters.

view.cardsTooltip: Browse the maps as cards with their minimaps
view.tableTooltip: Compare all the map data in a sortable table

card.notInLobbyTooltip: This map is not selectable in the in-game lobby.

detail.author: Author
detail.playableAreaTooltip: Bounding box of the capture points - the part of the map the fighting happens on. Always smaller than the full map size.
detail.incomePerSideTooltip: Half of the total income. Maps are close to symmetrical, but points in the middle of the map are contested rather than split, so treat this as an estimate.
detail.incomeNote: Income of all capturable points at full control, per minute.
detail.hoverHint: Hover over any point on the map to see its details:

hoverDetails.tier: Tier of the point (extra low up to high)
hoverDetails.captureTime: Capture time - how long it takes to take it
hoverDetails.revertTime: Revert time - how long until it goes neutral again

detail.tierSizeHint: The icons on the map are sized by tier, so the higher yield points are the bigger ones.
detail.sectorsTooltip: Draw the territory sectors on the map. A point is only connected to your base once you hold the chain of sectors leading to it.
